references.text: Parallel text that also refers to the eighth day as a holy assembly (עֲצֶרֶת) where no work is to be done.
Further description of the eighth day as a solemn assembly following the Feast of Tabernacles.
Moses repeats the commandment regarding the eighth day as a solemn assembly (עֲצֶרֶת) for the Lord.
Describes the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days, followed by a solemn assembly on the eighth day, as prescribed by the law.
Solomon celebrates the dedication of the altar and holds a solemn assembly on the eighth day before sending the people home.
Jesus speaks on the last, great day of the Feast of Tabernacles, which refers to this eighth day with its solemn assembly.
